name: What should I bring or prepare for my first HIIT class at Cave Training?
description: Wear athletic clothing and shoes, bring water, and arrive early. Inform your coach of any physical limitations or injuries before starting.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring or prepare for my first HIIT class at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: For your first HIIT class, you should wear comfortable athletic clothing and supportive closed-toe shoes. Bring a water bottle to stay hydrated, as these sessions are dynamic and can be demanding. Arriving a few minutes early is also beneficial, as it allows you to get acquainted with the facility and meet your coach. At Cave Training, we recommend discussing any prior injuries or physical limitations with your coach beforehand so they can provide appropriate modifications and ensure a safe, effective workout tailored to your needs.
